thread:
jane_support: FYI Acme-prod reported a big burst and our Dedicated pool didn't ramp. Customers saw 429s + 5-12s token latency. Attaching quick repro and control-plane snippets.

jane_support: repro curl they ran:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-7b-q4","input":"ping"}'
```

ops_bot: [autoscaler] event: scale_request queued for pool=acme-prod-1 desired_replicas=10 current=2 min_replicas=2 reason=surge_detected

jane_support: quick copy of the Dedicated config the customer has: 
```yaml
route: /v1/generate
model: rw-7b-q4
dedicated_pool: acme-prod-1
autoscale:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 50
  targetCPU: 70
  warmPool: enabled
  probeTimeoutMs: 10000
```

ryan_eng_runtime: thanks. can you drop the control-plane logs (autoscaler + attach controller) and a short timeframe? also which region + instance type?

jane_support: logs pasted below from 2026-03-15 14:22Z window: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:22:10Z] autoscaler: scaleUp request requested=8 current=2 pending=6
[2026-03-15T14:22:11Z] attach-controller: attach queued imagePull starting for pod=acme-prod-1-xx
[2026-03-15T14:22:12Z] registry: pull rate limited for acme-prod-1 nodes (429)
[2026-03-15T14:22:13Z] attach-controller: imagePullBackOff on node gpu-12
[2026-03-15T14:22:14Z] probe: heartbeat failed for new-pod, probeTimeout=10000ms
[2026-03-15T14:22:20Z] autoscaler: desired=10 -> still scaling, warmpool_attach_inflight=3
[2026-03-15T14:22:35Z] request-gateway: 429 upstream: warmpool attach backlog
```

ashwin_sre: OK this looks like a classic warm-pool attach + image-pull backoff cascade. registry rate limiting -> image pulls stall -> pods don't become Ready -> autoscaler keeps requesting but never reaches desired. two parallel asks: 1) confirm cloud quota and registry rate limits, 2) check warmpool instance provisioning/concurrency.

lucas_platform: also check if minReplicas=2 is too low for their burst pattern. warmPool helps but if attach stalls it doesn't help. short-term mitigation: bump minReplicas to 6 for this pool or enable reserved_burst if the customer has that add-on.

devex_maya: can we repro in staging with a controlled replay? if yes, we should run a 2-min 8x burst and watch warmpool attach metrics. command we use: `rictl simulate-burst --pool acme-prod-1 --rps 8000 --duration 120s`

ryan_eng_runtime: actionable steps:
- ask customer to temporarily raise minReplicas to 6 (or we can do it if they'd consent)
- confirm registry pull quotas with infra (possible rate-limit)
- run staging replay to confirm attach-backoff pattern
- if registry-rate-limit is the root cause, enable node image caching or pre-pulled warm images for that pool

jane_support: customer agreed to temporary change, I updated their pool to minReplicas=6 and will monitor. they also granted permission for us to pre-pull images.

ops_bot: [action] created ticket RI-ACME-453 (investigate registry throttling & warmpool behavior). assigned to ashwin_sre. SLA: 24h.

ashwin_sre: I'll start investigating provider-side pull quotas and attach controller logs. early hypothesis: noisy neighbor caused registry retries + backoff, exacerbated by low minReplicas.

lucas_platform: longer-term work: consider a warm-pool health gate — if warmpool_attach_inflight > N and imagePullBackOff rate > X then temporarily shadow-route to hosted pool or fallback smaller model automatically. logging this as a product suggestion.

jane_support: customer reports 429s dropped from ~15% -> ~1% within 4 minutes after bumping minReplicas. will keep monitoring.

ryan_eng_runtime: thanks team. please paste any repro steps/metrics into RI-ACME-453 ticket and tag me. we should consider a KB entry: "Dedicated pool attach stalls (registry throttling)".

ops_bot: [note] thread closed for now, reopen if regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
